title: Out-of-Area Reimbursement Schedule, Road Hazard Protection
content:
Schedule of the figures that govern reimbursement under Road Hazard Protection when a holder pays a shop outside the Crestline network for a covered repair or replacement: the distance from the nearest Crestline store beyond which a third-party service may be reimbursed, the most reimbursed for one repair and for one replacement, the receipt window and the documents a reimbursement needs.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Distance from the nearest Crestline store beyond which a third-party service may be reimbursed, miles | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Most reimbursed for one out-of-area repair | 25.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 30.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 40.00 USD | 35.00 USD |
| Most reimbursed for one out-of-area replacement, before the coverage percentage | 0.00 USD (not reimbursed) | 125.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 175.00 USD | 200.00 USD | 175.00 USD |
| Receipt window, calendar days after the service date on the receipt | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Documents required | itemized receipt; the damaged tire or a photo of it | itemized receipt; the damaged tire or a photo of it | itemized receipt; the damaged tire or a photo of it | itemized receipt; the damaged tire or a photo of it | itemized receipt; the damaged tire or a photo of it | itemized receipt; the damaged tire or a photo of it |

**Notes.**
- A replacement cap of 0.00 means the plan does not reimburse out-of-area replacements; on the 12-Month plan only an out-of-area repair can be reimbursed.
- The receipt window is counted in calendar days from the day after the service date on the receipt, so a hypothetical receipt dated on the 1st of a 31-day month can be submitted up to the 31st, and not on the day after.
